items.title: NHAI floats Rs 11538 crore tenders for Amaravati Outer Ring Road
items.summary: Follow TNM ’ s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has invited bids for the construction of the proposed six-lane, access-controlled Amaravati Outer Ring Road (ORR), with the 195.23-km project divided into four packages under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM). The tenders, issued on October 2, carry a combined estimated cost of Rs 11,537.70 crore. Each package has a construction schedule of 1,095 days, or three years. Bidders must submit their offers by 11 am on November 18, with the bids scheduled to be opened the following day. The first package covers the 27.93-km stretch between Kanchikacherla and Nandigama at an estimated cost of Rs 2,975.47 crore. Package 2, the longest at 56 km, will connect Nandigama with Davuluru and has been pegged at Rs 2,864.69 crore. The third package, estimated at Rs 2,827.95 crore, covers 55.80 km between Kolavennu and Kornepadu. It also includes a 5.3-km spur connecting the ORR to Narakoduru. The final package spans 55.50 km from Kornepadu to Kanchikacherla and is estimated to cost Rs 2,869.59 crore. Once completed, the ring road is expected to provide a high-capacity alternative for traffic
